description: Pre-fix commit references for each known Solana exploit. Use re_discovery_runner.py for automated regression.

exploits.name: cashio_2022
exploits.pre_fix_note: Cashio was a one-shot exploit, repo wasn't actively patched after the exploit. Whole HEAD is effectively pre-fix.
exploits.validation_evidence: owner_check_scanner found `collateral @ lib.rs:252` as [known_class] critical, 5 novel surface gaps

exploits.name: wormhole_2022
exploits.pre_fix_note: Date-based lookup for the last commit before the Wormhole signature_verify exploit (Feb 2-3, 2022).
exploits.validation_note: Wormhole is native Solana (uses next_account_info iterator), not Anchor. Our scanners detect Anchor patterns Account<T>/#[account(...)]. Native scanner = future work item.

exploits.name: mango_2022
exploits.pre_fix_note: Avraham Eisenberg market-manipulation. Not strictly a code bug (governance attack) — but the oracle resilience surface is measurable.
exploits.validation_command: git -C mango-v3 fetch --unshallow && git -C mango-v3 checkout $(git -C mango-v3 log --before=2022-10-11 -1 --format=%H) && python3 scripts/sol/hypothesis/oracle_integration_audit.py --target mango-v3/program/src

exploits.name: crema_2022
exploits.pre_fix_note: Tick array manipulation. Source partially open — may need binary analysis fallback (Heimdall/sBPF).

exploits.name: raydium_clmm_2024

exploits.name: loopscale_2025
exploits.pre_fix_note: Loopscale source not public pre-exploit. Workaround: study post-mortem + recreate pattern in test project.

exploits.name: marginfi_2025
exploits.pre_fix_note: $160M prevented. Asymmetric Research disclosed. State flag ACCOUNT_IN_FLASHLOAN bypass via new transfer instruction.
exploits.validation_note: Pre-fix state (67ab029e~1) checked out. state_route_analyzer returns 0 findings. Bug needs recent_audit_diff_analyzer which detects new instruction handler added without state flag check. Bug class = 'post-audit new handler omits guard' — different from state_route alternatives. Re-test when recent_audit_diff_analyzer is applied to the marginfi git log
